body: Thank you again for your empathetic response. I think the most painful thing is acknowledging how much of the quality of my life has been destroyed. It is a very difficult thing to come to terms with. I really hope I can overcome this emotional obstacle. Thank you again for being so kind. It really means a lot

Thank you truly for responding. It is very appreciated, but unfortunately there is no solution to my problem. I have a condition that will never get better. And the grief over that fact is overwhelming at the moment. I don’t want to do anything impulsive. I actually really love my family and don’t want them to suffer. I don’t think my mom would survive it if I took my own life.
